svg.title: Svetoslav Mutev, Full-stack developer, agent orchestrator. I brief, Explore and Plan prepare the work, lara, fronty and designer build in parallel, code-reviewer checks it, I give the final review, then it ships.
svg.text: I design the system. A crew of AI agents
builds it in parallel, and every change
Blue ink: built by the crew
Red pencil: my calls and the final review
my review: not yet? back to the crew
rule of the day: refactors and features never share a commit
